objects.taxonomy_description: Adult castrated bovine measuring 140-180 cm at withers weighing 400-900 kg. Body massive and muscular with short dense coat in white, brown, black, or pied coloration. Head broad with wide muzzle. Horns curved laterally and upward (if not dehorned). Eyes large and dark with wide field of vision. Ears large and mobile. Neck thick and muscular with prominent dewlap. Body deep-chested with strong back. Legs sturdy with cloven hooves. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, hair insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Croissant（牛角包）是一种具有特定几何形态和表面纹理的烘焙面点，不属于生物分类范畴。

diagnostic_checkpoints.整体形态: 呈现标志性的新月形或角状弯曲结构，两端尖细，中间膨大。
diagnostic_checkpoints.表面纹理: 表面具有清晰可见的层状剥离结构（千层酥皮），显示出面团折叠烘烤后的分层特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.色泽特征: 整体呈均匀的金黄色至深褐色，表面通常带有烘烤产生的光泽，无生物表皮特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.结构完整性: 为单一连续的固体食物单元，无头尾、四肢或器官等生物解剖结构。

objects.taxonomy_description: Small Old World monkey measuring 30-60 cm body length weighing 2-8 kg. Body covered with long hair around face forming distinctive facial ruff. Fur coloration variable by species in gray, brown, olive, or red. Face bare with expressive features. Eyes forward-facing with brown irises. Nose narrow. Ears small. Tail long and non-prehensile. Hind limbs elongated. Body slender and agile. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. African arboreal monkey with complex social behavior.

Head_and_Face: Long hair around face forming distinctive facial ruff.
Body_and_Plumage: Body with variable size ranging from small to moderately large across species.
Fur coloration variable by species in gray, brown, olive, or red.
